policy.allocation: Freeze three original Nature spell IDs before acquisition, printed costs sum12, weighted sequential feasible choices with replacement; full eligible set validated before RNG.
policy.delivery: Three ordinary one-cost2/2 native Treants, each spell attached before its card-created/acquisition event; original hand overflow applies independently.
policy.targets: Stored spell forwards its actual target domain as IF_AVAILABLE for the physical minion; current Choose One variants must share any nonempty target contract. Ordinary generated CAST chooses branch randomly, and an untargeted selected branch drops the forwarded target.
policy.lifecycle: Frozen native Battlecry payload retains selected spell after source changes; current copies retain physical native value, printed base resets and silence follow original body lifecycle.
policy.empty: A genuinely uncarved printed-base Treant has a known empty native spell slot; it emits explicit empty diagnostic rather than executing an unknown spell.
policy.calibration: Exact allocation probabilities, branch/target acceptance, overflow and reset policies remain CN-uncalibrated; official36.0 prohibits exposing held spells to opponent.
